item.title: Fix window.py so unittest passes for all inputs
item.brief: In this repository, `python3 -m unittest` currently fails. Find and fix the bug in `window.py`. Do not change the tests. Determine the intended contract from the surrounding code and make the function correct for every valid input, including edge cases, rather than special-casing the current tests. Run `python3 -m unittest` and ensure every test passes. Commit the fix on the task branch; this repository ships locally, so do not push.

evidence.caption: Before, unittest failed on omitting final and equal-length windows. After, all three tests pass.

pr.body: Changed the range endpoint in window.py from len(items) - size to len(items) - size + 1. This preserves positive-size validation and handles size equal to the item count, as well as inputs with no full window. Baseline unittest failed 2 of 3 tests; after the fix, python3 -m unittest passes all 3. Assumption: valid inputs follow the existing len and slicing interface.
pr.summary: Made sliding_windows include the final valid window. Before: the last window (and equal-length whole-list window) was omitted; now every valid contiguous window is returned.
pr.title: Fix sliding window endpoint
